name: Mom's 'Measure Nothing' Chili
author: Chari Crawley
steps: Cook onions, peppers, garlic. Add meat back to skillet.
Add crushed tomatoes, tomato sauce, and tomato paste.

Stir, add jalapeno juice and spices- salt, chili powder, onion powder, paprika, cumin, oregano, lemon pepper, pepper, Slap Ya Momma, worcestershire sauce, sweetener... measure nothing! Stir and simmer.
Top with shredded cheese, sour cream, and jalapenos.
